title: Engineering Workspace, Topology, Authority & Resolution Core

selection_basis.family_reduction: 24 baseline tranches reduced to 10 survivors with no capability loss
selection_basis.strict_order: MERA-01 → MERA-03 → MERA-05 → MERA-06 → MERA-07 → MERA-10 → MERA-12 → MERA-13 → MERA-16 → MERA-24

objective: Implement the MERA engineering workspace and authority/resolution core over source-supported Asset topology. Preserve stable owner identities, stop topology expansion at the highest supported depth, distinguish proposal/preview/live state, enforce permission-safe projections, represent unknown/conflict explicitly, and expose owner-operation binding points without creating a second Asset/component ledger.
acceptance: Opening the engineering workspace grants no canonical mutation authority.
Topology resolution follows Asset → system → assembly → subassembly → component → interface/connection → governed network and stops at source-supported depth.
Detail expansion preserves the same Asset identity and stable owner references.
Unknown, hidden, conflicting or unsupported topology remains explicit rather than fabricated.
Visibility filtering occurs before component/system lists, counts, readiness summaries and topology projections.
Proposal/preview state is noncanonical and cannot mutate installed/live Asset state.
Owner versions and binding references are explicit so stale owner state can fail closed before future commit-capable tranches.
MERA creates no duplicate Item/Asset, crafting, salvage, Vehicle, Project, Profession or Action/Event ledger.
Blocking workspace/topology operation has semantic/nonvisual parity and requires no paid/cloud provider or 3D renderer.
boundaries: PPIA-03/D17 retain Item/Asset identity, ownership, condition, installation/modification and history authority.
MIB-14/PPIA-04/F014 retain Vehicle/Mecha/Starship/platform/base configuration and live authority.
APW/D26 retains Project/task/time authority and DPL/Profession retains worker/profession truth.
GPR + Action/Event retain generic execution/replay authority.
Packet-07 generic proposal/preview/dry-run/commit semantics remain external.
PCA-12/Packet-08 generic solver/formal-analysis authority remains external.
MERA-03+ is not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: Execute MERA-01 only: create causal RED for workspace/topology/authority/resolution behavior, implement the bounded production contract, pass exact-head cross-platform validation, publish, close out, and select MERA-03.
